response.sql:
WITH tel_avg AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg
  FROM tel_avg
)
SELECT t.telescref,
       t.avg_modindex,
       t.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall,
       t.avg_modindex / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall
FROM tel_avg t
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE t.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg
ORDER BY ratio_to_overall DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes whose modindex values are all NULL have no per-telescope average, so they are excluded from the overall mean. The overall average is the mean of the per-telescope averages over telescopes with at least one non-null modindex.
Telescopes are grouped by signals.telescref. Missing modindex values are ignored by filtering them out before averaging, which is equivalent to AVG ignoring NULLs.
